---
title: Judging platen hardness
summary: A fingernail is the first gauge.
topic: platen
---

Fresh rubber takes the mark of a fingernail and gives it back within a second. A platen that rings like a billiard ball when tapped with a pencil has hardened, and it will punch periods straight through thin paper. Recovering the roller is a job for a specialist workshop, but a backing sheet of heavy stock behind the page softens the blow in the meantime.
